lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 1 test, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

candidates.title: Sign-In Deferred To Post-Waiting Stage
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the waiting screen before entering the home intro, allowing users to experience pet creation before registering.
candidates.why: Sign-in reorder changes previously showed positive impact in testing, and delaying account creation lowers friction during initial onboarding.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion Profile
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across all your devices.

guard.reason: Reordering the sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering showed mild positive impact (+1.0%) in previous tests.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Persona Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen into an interactive full-bleed carousel showing animated pet behaviors and trait cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step has 71.7% conversion with high median time (89s); standard grid choices create hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen into a carousel retains its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns consistently underperformed or worsened conversion (-4.2%).

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Progress Notification Flow
candidates.change: Introduce interactive setup activities and auto-notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets are generated.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off while waiting.

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[0]': timer text must read like 'About 4 min left' (at most 30 min)

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Modes Screen
candidates.change: Add a new dedicated screen introducing key mouse gestures and keyboard shortcuts for interacting with the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Ready to Meet Your Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop!

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_interaction_guide']

candidates.title: Path Selection Value Proposition Copy
candidates.change: Clarify the differences between adopting a standard pet and generating a custom pet with direct path outcome descriptions.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, spending an average of 514s trying to decide between onboarding paths.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Experience
choose_path.hint: Choose a pre-made pet for quick setup, or create a unique companion from photos.

guard.reason: Updated copy preserves both path choices clearly.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change targeting moderate drop-off and high completion time on choose_path.

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync Safety Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassurance hint explaining that signing in restores previous pets and preserves desktop settings across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, causing user anxiety during login.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pets and customizations are stored securely and synced everywhere.

guard.reason: Sign-in hint provides account sync reassurance without asking for new personal data.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails; simple config hint reduces sign-in friction.

candidates.title: Photo Processing Duration Estimate Notice
candidates.change: Display estimated processing time and real-time status cues when uploading custom pet photos.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (71.7% conversion) and long mean completion time (1017s) due to photo uploading.

upload_photos.hint: Photo analysis usually takes 15-30 seconds. Higher quality photos produce better pets.

guard.reason: Photo processing estimate is informative and reflects actual creation wait time.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high adoption drop-off (71.7%) and long mean completion time (1017s).

candidates.title: Pet Ready Desktop Push Notification
candidates.change: Enable a system notification that alerts the user when pet generation finishes if they switch away from the app.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s on the waiting screen, leading to lost engagement.

waiting.headline: We're Crafting Your Companion
waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you as soon as your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Adding system notifications during the waiting stage is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Push notifications help re-engage users during long home generation wait times (mean 2336s).

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Guidance Layout
candidates.change: Reframe home intro screen using a two-column layout highlighting pet care quick actions alongside desktop shortcut keys.
candidates.why: Finish step has only 64.8% completion rate and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding controls.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your New Companion
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, feed, and interact with your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off, but screen/layout modifications historically hurt conversion (-2.0%).

candidates.title: Certificate Naming Charm Incentive
candidates.change: Award an exclusive starter accessory badge right on the adoption certificate when the user gives their pet a name.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off (71.7% conversion) and reinforcing certificate completion boosts progression.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras/unlocked items ('Starter Collar Unlocked').
